name: Core Deposit Growth Reward Rule
description: Rewards branch core-deposit balance growth vs annual operating plan target; capped at 130% to avoid rewarding aggressive rate-chasing.

name: Net Income Achievement Reward Rule
description: Links variable pay to branch/business-unit net income against the annual operating plan; company modifier scales pool by enterprise result.

name: Cost-to-Income Ratio Reward Rule
description: Rewards efficiency improvement (lower cost-to-income); inverted achievement since lower ratio is better.

name: Net Interest Margin Reward Rule
description: Rewards net interest margin performance vs target; risk gate guards against margin gains from imprudent maturity transformation.

name: Loan Portfolio Quality (NPL Ratio) Reward Rule
description: Rewards keeping the nonperforming-loan ratio at/below target; lower-is-better objective central to credit-quality alignment.

name: Net Charge-off Rate Reward Rule
description: Rewards containment of net charge-off rate; ex-post malus applies if losses crystallise after payout per risk-adjustment guidance.

name: Tier 1 Capital Ratio Stewardship Reward Rule
description: Rewards maintaining the Tier 1 capital ratio above regulatory and internal targets; tight cap to discourage gaming.

name: Customer Satisfaction / NPS Reward Rule
description: Rewards Net Promoter Score / customer satisfaction gains; customer-harm gate blocks payout where complaints or mis-selling are evidenced.

name: Customer Retention Rate Reward Rule
description: Rewards retention of the existing customer base against target; conduct gate guards against retention via undisclosed fee traps.

name: Cross-Sell / Product Penetration Reward Rule
description: Rewards products-per-customer cross-sell ratio; gated heavily after industry mis-selling lessons to prevent unsuitable product pushing.

name: New Customer Acquisition Reward Rule
description: Rewards new-customer penetration against the branch acquisition target.

name: Fee Transparency Operations Reward Rule
description: Rewards share of operations with fees disclosed beforehand; supports treating-customers-fairly conduct standards.

name: Cybersecurity Readiness Reward Rule
description: Rewards progress on the cybersecurity readiness framework score; audit-finding gate suppresses payout on open critical findings.

name: Digital Channel Adoption Reward Rule
description: Rewards migration of transactions to digital channels vs target; conduct gate guards against forced digital migration of vulnerable customers.

name: AML/KYC Case Accuracy Reward Rule
description: Rewards accuracy/timeliness of AML-KYC case handling; a failed compliance gate hard-blocks the entire variable payout.

name: Regulatory Breach Avoidance Reward Rule
description: Binary-style rule: zero material regulatory breaches required to earn any payout on this objective; pure gating component.

name: Conduct & Complaints Reward Rule
description: Rewards low upheld-complaint volume; conduct and customer-harm gates make this a primary risk-adjustment lever.

name: Mandatory Training Completion Reward Rule
description: Requires 100% completion of mandatory compliance/conduct training; feeds the TRAINING_GATE that blocks payout when incomplete.

name: Role Certification Currency Reward Rule
description: Requires current role-required certifications (e.g. MiFID/IDD advice licences); drives the CERTIFICATION_GATE.

name: Employee Engagement Reward Rule
description: Rewards team engagement / culture survey score improvement vs target.

name: Sustainable / ESG Lending Reward Rule
description: Rewards growth in sustainable/ESG-aligned lending share against the strategic transition target.

name: Non-Interest (Fee) Income Reward Rule
description: Rewards diversification into non-interest fee income; conduct gating prevents fee income earned through unfair charging.

name: Individual MBO Objectives Reward Rule
description: Rewards achievement of individual management-by-objectives goals; 20% individual weight per the common 60/20/20 split.

name: Branch Balanced-Scorecard Team Reward Rule
description: Rewards composite branch balanced-scorecard team result; aggregates financial/customer/process/learning perspectives into one team factor.
